name: Defender's Boon
description: Increases Defense or Magic Defense by 1. This applies to the lower of the two attributes; if they have the same value, this augmentation has no effect.

name: Elemental Veil
description: Reduces the damage taken from abilities of one type chosen from the following list by 1 : fire-aspected, ice-aspected, wind-aspected, earth-aspected, lightning-aspected, water-aspected. Choose the type when purchasing this augmentation.

name: Elemental Veil II
description: Reduces the damage taken from abilities of three types chosen from the following list by 1 : fire-aspected, ice-aspected, wind-aspected, earth-aspected, lightning-aspected, water-aspected. Choose the types when purchasing this augmentation.
